summary: Iteration 7 - DutyConnect M4 Stage A (Google Play subscriptions, BILLING_MODE=mock) frontend E2E, viewport 390x844, user delivered+t1@resend.dev. All in-scope flows PASS. (1) FREE: Account shows 'Free plan' + subrow 'Free – upgrade'; opening it loads upgrade-screen with upgrade-comparison (Feature/Free/Pro table), upgrade-plan-monthly / upgrade-plan-annual (Monthly · £2.99, Annual · £24.99), upgrade-subscribe-button, upgrade-unavailable-note ('Subscriptions are available in the Google Play version of DutyConnect (not in Expo Go or the web preview).'), upgrade-restore-button; upgrade-manage-button absent. Tapping upgrade-subscribe-button on web shows the info toast 'Subscriptions are available in the Google Play version of DutyConnect.'. Earnings shows earnings-pro-prompt and NO earnings-period-week/month/year segmented and NO earnings-by-duty. Export sheet shows export-csv-button + export-pdf-pro-prompt (no export-pdf-button). On a completed shift seeded 5 days ago with 1 payment of £60 (Recent Hospital), payments-panel shows payment-pro-prompt and NO payment-add-button. Shifts → List → History hides the 60-day-old 'Old Hospital' shift and shows history-older-prompt '1 older shift is safely stored  Free shows the last 30 days. View every record by exporting a CSV (Account → Export my data), or upgrade to browse them here.' (2) PRO (via Mongo mock_play insert + POST /api/billing/verify {product_id:'dutyconnect_pro_annual', purchase_token:'tok-ui-1-aaaa'} → 200, plan='pro', state='SUBSCRIPTION_STATE_ACTIVE', will_renew=true): account-plan-text = 'Pro plan'; account-subscription-row = 'Pro · renews 12 October 2027'; account-manage-subscription-row visible. Earnings now shows earnings-period-week / month / year, earnings-by-duty table (Bed Watch / Constant Watch (1 shift · 4h · £60 received, £80) / Other PP) and no earnings-pro-prompt. Export sheet shows export-pdf-button and no export-pdf-pro-prompt. On the Recent Hospital shift payments-panel shows payment-add-button and no payment-pro-prompt. Shifts → History shows the 60-day-old 'Old Hospital' and no history-older-prompt. Upgrade screen while Pro shows upgrade-manage-button and renewal text 'Renews automatically on 12 October 2027.'; upgrade-subscribe-button + upgrade-plan-monthly are absent. (3) DOWNGRADE (set mock SUBSCRIPTION_STATE_EXPIRED with past expiryTime + POST /api/billing/restore → 200, plan='free'): account-plan-text back to 'Free plan', subrow back to 'Free – upgrade', account-manage-subscription-row removed, earnings-pro-prompt and export-pdf-pro-prompt return, period segmented + by-duty + export-pdf-button all gone, export-csv-button still available. No shifts or payments were lost at the DB level (confirmed via Mongo count: pp_shifts still had both Old Hospital + Recent Hospital with the £60 payment after restore; the fresh test browser session for this downgrade check had a different device_id than the one that set sync_device during the Pro session, so Free's single-sync-phone rule hid the pull in that specific session — this is correct Free-plan behaviour, not data loss, and is reflected in the backend). (4) Regression: home-sync-blocked-banner did NOT appear in the first Free browser session (after the seed cleared sync_device). Home, Shifts (Month/Week/List), Calendar, Earnings, Account, and the recent-shift payments-panel all render and respond. No React Native red screens during the final run. (5) Residual console warnings carried over from earlier iterations only: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. No new deprecated packages introduced. User reset to Free after testing (subscriptions and mock_play docs deleted, users.plan='free', sync_device unset; residual seed shifts also removed).

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' – pre-existing from iteration 1, not M4 scope.

action_items: No functional M4-A frontend defects found. All testIDs listed in the spec render and behave to spec on Free, Pro, and after downgrade.
Nice-to-have (carryover from iter 1): migrate residual shadow* → boxShadow and prop pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents to silence the two console warnings.
Nice-to-have: export sheet's export-close-button sits below the viewport on 390x844 when the sheet has a long content area (both Free and Pro) – not blocking, but worth noting for small screens.
critical_code_review_comments: upgrade.tsx:40-50 subscribe() correctly delegates to buy() which on web/Expo Go throws 'Subscriptions are available in the Google Play version of DutyConnect.' and shows it as an info toast – observed verbatim at runtime.

upgrade.tsx:104-125 the Pro vs Free fork is clean: when !isPro the segmented + subscribe + unavailable-note + restore render; when isPro the manage-button renders with the correct SKU. Hero body switches to 'Renews automatically on <date>.' when ent.will_renew, which was observed.
account.tsx:79-99 subscription row text builds the renewal line via endDate(ent?.expires_at) and only renders account-manage-subscription-row when isPro – matches both tested states.
earnings.tsx:66-95 gates period segmented AND the earnings-by-duty section on isPro and swaps to ProPrompt earnings-pro-prompt when Free – matches spec exactly.

payments-panel.tsx:145-150 Record payment button is replaced by payment-pro-prompt when Free AND the shift already has at least one active payment (`isPro || active.length === 0`) – spec-compliant: Free gets one payment per shift, additional payments require Pro.

shift-list-view.tsx:45-46 FREE history cutoff uses addDays(toISODate(now), -30) and is only applied in History tab + when !isPro; olderHidden count feeds history-older-prompt. Confirmed at runtime (1 shift 60-days-old hidden with the correct prompt; prompt vanished on Pro).

billing.py:118-146 apply_google_state binds purchases to the user via account_ref and refuses mismatched ones (observed path: verify → acknowledge → refresh_plan) – covered by the mock DB path which this iteration exercised via POST /verify and /restore.

export-sheet.tsx:58-62 Pro gate replaces export-pdf-button with ProPrompt export-pdf-pro-prompt titled 'PDF reports with Pro' body 'CSV export of all your records is always free.' – observed verbatim.

success_rate.backend: N/A this iteration (skipped per request; main agent reports 145/145)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on everything in-scope for M4 Stage A — Free gating (plan text, subrow, upgrade screen, earnings pro-prompt, export pdf pro-prompt, payment-pro-prompt, 30-day history + older-prompt, info toast on subscribe), Pro unlocks (plan text, subrow with renewal, manage-subscription-row, period segmented + by-duty, pdf export button, payment-add-button, older shifts visible, upgrade manage-button + renewal text), Downgrade (plan rolls back to Free, Pro-only UI disappears, CSV export still available, shifts/payments preserved in DB).

seed_data_creation: During testing one 60-day-old 'Old Hospital' completed shift and one 5-day-old 'Recent Hospital' completed shift with a £60 payment were inserted into pp_shifts, plus one mock_play doc for token 'tok-ui-1-aaaa' and one subscriptions row for product dutyconnect_pro_annual. All cleaned up at end: pp_shifts, subscriptions, mock_play all 0 for the user; users.plan='free', sync_device unset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server reports date 2026-10-12 (not Jan 2026 as the system prompt header says). Login flow needs an extra click on 'Sign in' on the entry screen. Auth testIDs are login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button. Tab testIDs tab-home / tab-shifts / tab-earnings / tab-account. The Shifts tab defaults to Month view – click 'List' to reach shifts-list-view then shifts-list-tab-history. Shift details is a modal sheet; pressing Escape in Playwright opens the Delete-shift confirm (keyboard shortcut for the delete button), so use await page.go_back() to close it. Billing: POST /api/billing/verify requires purchase_token.min_length=10 (so I used 'tok-ui-1-aaaa'); POST /api/billing/restore marks the mock record EXPIRED and reconciles plan='free'. Free's single-sync-phone rule means every new Playwright browser session is a different device_id and may hit sync-blocked after the first session set users.sync_device – reset_to_free in /app/test_reports/seed_m4a_billing.py $unsets sync_device so you can iterate safely. The seed helper takes 'seed_free_shift' | 'go_pro' | 'downgrade' | 'reset_to_free' and auto-logs the user_id from the JWT. Entitlement endpoint: GET /api/billing/entitlement returns {plan, account_ref, pass, ...}; the signed Ed25519 pass is validated client-side by passPlan() in /app/frontend/src/billing/entitlement.tsx against EXPO_PUBLIC_ENTITLEMENT_PUBLIC_KEY.
rca_of_issue: No defects identified. The DutyConnect M4 Stage A Free/Pro gating, upgrade/restore mock-Google flow, subscription row + renewal date, Pro-only earnings dashboard & PDF export, 30-day history cutoff for Free, and 'one payment per shift' rule for Free all behave exactly as specified.
